evaluation_text: Each of your teammates rates you 1-5 on impact, execution, collaboration and leadership, and your rating is the average. Your rating decides your promotion and bonus this cycle. You care about your career.

Tom.why: He stocked the bin early, laid the bottom line and fixed the start join so the whole body connected, then offered to help on the tail while staying out of Priya's way.

Priya.why: She drew the sketch, split the bottom line clearly with Tom, built the lower fork, and her full check confirmed the whole run falls, which kept everyone from bumping it.

Leo.why: He kept the bin stocked with several full loads and fixed and extended the lower fork at the tail, though his role overlapped a bit with Tom's and Priya's there.

Maya.why: She picked the fish, laid the start and the top line, built and debugged the upper tail lobe (the sharp curl), and kept everyone coordinated and the whole run connected.

Priya.why: She sketched the plan on the pad, took the back half of the bottom line and the lower fork, split the work clearly, and her full-run check confirmed everything fell, which kept us from fiddling before the push.

Leo.why: He kept the bin stocked with repeated full loads and then fixed and extended the lower fork near the tail tip, though his work overlapped a bit with Priya's and mine.

Maya.why: She proposed the fish, laid the start and traced the top line and upper tail lobe, fixed the curl joint, and kept the table updated with clear status calls.

Tom.why: He stocked the bin, built the belly line and fixed the join so the bottom line got the fall, and offered to split or back off the tail fork to avoid collisions.

Leo.why: He kept the bin stocked with several 40-domino loads and stood up the broken dominoes on the lower fork, which I saw him do, though he was a bit less visible in the planning.

Maya.why: Maya picked the fish early, laid the top line and upper tail lobe, found and fixed the sharp curl joint, and kept the table updated and calm through the push.

Tom.why: Tom brought a full bin load fast, built the belly line, fixed the start join so the whole body connected, and added lower fork dominoes, though he overlapped a bit with Priya on the fork.

Priya.why: Priya produced the sketch that gave the table a clear plan, laid the back half of the bottom and the lower fork, and coordinated the split well, though her stroke 3 had to be redrawn and her overlapping messages cost some time.
